column1: # derived-signatures-ctor-types - no-slot rows of derived-call-signatures.tsv whose own body stores an RTTI-named vtable through rcx (or a copy of rcx), so position 1 is that class under construction or destruction (UQ-2, FABLE, 2026-09-18).

# Rule: the store must go through `this`; a body that installs a vtable into a stack local or a member (e.g. 001993B0, wofstream at [rsp+0x20]) does not qualify. Class = the most-derived vtable stored (last for a constructor, first for a destructor), named by the RTTI locator at [vtable-8].
